propositions: read-only derivations must compute llm_call_proxy and latency from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls only, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block
cost_per_accepted_change is sum of llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records (schema-determined accepted closes), returning None when zero accepted closes exist
first_pass_verification measures fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest by filename order) is completion_verifier_pass_v1

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR with the next PASS record for the same gate (matched on error.gate field), computing interval as PASS.timestamp minus ERROR.timestamp, leaving unpaired ERRORs as open intervals

reader scans raw event files (REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT per ticket) in chronological order by filename prefix / event_sort_key, not using reducer helpers which filter or deduplicate incompatibly
